supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: moderate extension beyond the outer corners of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: lighter muzzle and chin regions relative to the dark periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate vertical thickness with a neutral structural line

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: visible notch or missing segment in the upper-outer helix of the right ear

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: significant deformity on the right ear helix
other_distinctive_markers: extensive grey/white hair growth on the chin and lower muzzle area
